purpose: Teach: 覆い/明かさ/少数/気がつい/人民/調和/振れ/成人

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、世間に覆い隠された事実を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Your paper on hidden truths that society buries — that was quite something.
lines.style: Warm, genuinely curious. Leans in slightly. Steady pace, letting each phrase land. The tone of a teacher recognizing real work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、口を明かさなかった証人を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on witnesses who never came forward.
lines.style: Quiet precision. Brief pause before answering, as if checking his thoughts. Respectful but not deferential. Slight lift at the end, opening to follow-up.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 少数派の意見を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And that piece on minority voices — the perspectives people usually overlook.
lines.style: Thoughtful, nodding slightly. Slower pace. Not questioning, but genuinely turning it over in her mind. Warm recognition underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、調査時に気がついた偏りを論文で扱いました
lines.en: I noticed during the research how much the data was skewed. That's what I built the paper around.
lines.style: Measured delivery. Slight emphasis on 'noticed' — the moment of discovery. Not defensive, just stating what he found. Calm, direct.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 人民の自治を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And then your work on people finding their own voice — that matters.
lines.style: More energy here. Genuine engagement in the topic. Forward lean in the voice. Not lecturing — connecting with the significance of what he's doing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、伝統と現代の調和を論文で扱いました
lines.en: I explored how tradition and modern life could actually work together. That's what drew me to it.
lines.style: Slightly more open than before. A hint of personal investment in the words. Still measured, but there's something more present underneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 世論の振れ幅を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: The way public opinion shifts and changes — you really traced that through.
lines.style: Reflective, almost musing. Slow, appreciative pace. As if she's seeing the through-line of his work. Warm without being effusive.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、成人式の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Through the history of coming-of-age ceremonies, actually. How they've changed.
lines.style: A small breath after 'actually' — like he's been waiting to share this detail. Quieter close, but with genuine interest in the subject. Ending with gentle finality.
